unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Use elements (line, shape, colour, texture, space) and principles (hierarchy, scale, emphasis, contrast) to make strong artwork.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Brainstorm original project ideas from interests or themes, e.g. with mind maps or art journals.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Turn creative ideas into artwork with suitable techniques and media.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Try different materials, tools and techniques across drawing, painting, sculpture and digital art.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Apply specific techniques and media well to get the effect wanted.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Develop a personal style through experimenting with conventional and unconventional media.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Analyse the creative process, naming challenges and breakthroughs.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Critique your own work, naming strengths, weaknesses and improvements.

unit: Domain A: Artistic Exploration and Expression
outcome: Document and share your artistic journey through sketches, journals, statements and presentations.

unit: Domain B: Art History and Cultural Perspectives
outcome: Identify key features of art movements across periods and cultures, e.g. miniature art or Indus-valley sculpture.

unit: Domain B: Art History and Cultural Perspectives
outcome: Recognise how history and culture shaped art, e.g. tile work in Pakistan.

unit: Domain B: Art History and Cultural Perspectives
outcome: Use historical knowledge and critical thinking to interpret the meaning and purpose of artwork.

unit: Domain B: Art History and Cultural Perspectives
outcome: Apprentice with a local creative practitioner to learn the design and business side of their craft.

unit: Domain C: Creative Problem-solving and Design Thinking
outcome: Recognise and define problems needing creative solutions in architecture, art or product design.

unit: Domain C: Creative Problem-solving and Design Thinking
outcome: Develop and apply innovative solutions using critical thinking and design thinking, asking why.

unit: Domain D: Art Criticism and Communication
outcome: Use art vocabulary and critical thinking to analyse and interpret artwork.

unit: Domain D: Art Criticism and Communication
outcome: Use digital tools to present artwork to different audiences.

unit: Domain D: Art Criticism and Communication
outcome: Examine how art, design and creative practice drive social change and community development.
